name: auth
description: 14 icon untuk topic Authentication — 2 batch, keduanya sudah di-generate (AI-generate PNG via ChatGPT extension vm-icon-generator, per keputusan icon terkonfirmasi lewat eksekusi). Batch-1: objek inti (gerbang, penjaga, amplop bersegel, kartu ID, buku tamu, pencuri, mesin hash). Batch-2: session/token & authorization (kartu tamu bernomor, meja resepsionis, segel ajaib, 2 varian penjaga pintu, pintu terlarang, papan dual-stamp).

icons.label: Department Gate

icons.label: Gate Guard

icons.label: Sealed Letter

icons.name: ID Card Blank
icons.label: Identity Card
icons.description: Kartu identitas kosong bentuk persegi panjang sudut membulat, lingkaran foto placeholder di pojok kiri, 2 garis kosong untuk nama & kata sandi, warna biru (#38BDF8)

icons.name: Guestbook Open

batches.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist flat-design icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right, left-to-right, row by row:

1. Simple entrance gate icon — two upright pillars connected by a curved archway on top, flat outline style, cyan color (#06B6D4)
2. Simple cartoon face character wearing a small cap/uniform collar, alert/watchful expression, circle head with simple body outline below, orange color (#FB923C)
3. Closed envelope/letter with a small padlock icon attached directly on the seal flap, simple outline style, sky-blue color (#38BDF8) with the padlock accented in gold/yellow (#FBBF24)
4. Blank ID card — rounded rectangle badge shape, small circular photo placeholder in top-left corner, two empty horizontal lines below for name and password fields, sky-blue color (#38BDF8)
5. Large open book/guestbook spanning two pages, horizontal entry lines filling both pages, muted orange color (#FB923C)
6. Dark solid silhouette of a hunched figure peeking from behind a corner, no facial detail, small glowing red dot accents for eyes, dark charcoal body with red (#F43F5E) glow
7. Unique drum/turbine-shaped machine (NOT a plain box), narrow input slot on top, scrambled-pattern output slot on bottom, geometric control panel details on the body, purple color (#A78BFA)
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist, consistent visual weight across all icons
- Use ONLY the exact color specified per icon, no gradients
- Each icon same overall size, clearly distinct silhouette
- High contrast against transparent background
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 2 rows x 4 columns
- Recommended total size: 2048x1024 pixels (512x512 per icon)

batches.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist flat-design icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right, left-to-right, row by row:

1. Numbered visitor badge hanging from a lanyard strap, oval/rounded-rectangle card shape, large bold number in the center, purple color (#A78BFA)
2. Simple long reception desk counter, small bell icon on top of the desk, thin file rack visible behind it, orange color (#FB923C)
3. Round seal/token with a unique glowing rune-like pattern spread across its surface (different from a plain padlock), subtle shimmer effect, purple color (#A78BFA)
4. Simple cartoon face character (door officer variant 1) with a straight-brim cap, neutral expression, circle head with simple body outline below, bright orange color (#FB923C)
5. Simple cartoon face character (door officer variant 2), different cap shape and expression from variant 1, cyan color (#06B6D4) for clear contrast
6. Single door icon with a warning/restricted exclamation symbol on its center panel, bold outline style, red color (#F43F5E)
7. Badge/board containing two round stamps side by side — left stamp green with a checkmark (verified), right stamp purple and empty/unchecked (access permission), green (#34D399) and purple (#A78BFA)
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist, consistent visual weight across all icons
- Use ONLY the exact color specified per icon, no gradients
- Each icon same overall size, clearly distinct silhouette
- High contrast against transparent background
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 2 rows x 4 columns
- Recommended total size: 2048x1024 pixels (512x512 per icon)
